title: Scope every tool call, not every agent
excerpt: Per-call scopes keep a confused agent from spending a whole token.
htmlContent:
Agents act with borrowed authority, and a broad token turns one bad call into many.

Why scope per call

A per-call scope limits the blast radius of a confused agent.[1]

The gateway pattern

Rotate the gateway's signing key on every deploy.

What to do next

Start with the tool that can delete data.

Agents act with borrowed authority, and a broad token turns one bad call into many.

## Why scope per call

A per-call scope limits the blast radius of a confused agent.[^src-owasp]

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Agent] --> B[Gateway]
  B --> C[Tool]
```

### The gateway pattern

![Gateway issuing a scoped token per call](/api/media/uploads/2026-11/8a20d40ca664197613a433722a05122c1b2c1a4cc5548f909db6744db9a0f165.png)

:::note
Rotate the gateway's signing key on every deploy.
:::

## What to do next

Start with the tool that can delete data.
